name: White-stone mango
summary: The mango in the garden around Chùa Từ Quang. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam says the fruit went to the court, so it is also called xoài Ngự. The proverb on that article is “Xoài Đá Trắng, sắn phường Lụa”. The month is Check on arrival.
origin: Phu Yen. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam’s article on Chùa Từ Quang names xoài Đá Trắng.
culture: The bureau says the fruit went to the court, which is why it is also called xoài Ngự. The proverb on that article is “Xoài Đá Trắng, sắn phường Lụa”.
howToEat: Eat it as fruit. A month was not printed. Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.
where: The garden at Chùa Từ Quang. The bureau places the pagoda at xã An Dân, huyện Tuy An, about 35 km north, about 500 m from QL1A.
seoTitle: Xoai Da Trang — the mango at Chua Tu Quang
seoDescription: The mango in the garden at Chua Tu Quang, also called xoai Ngu. The month and a price are Check on arrival.
